# LearnForge — Corporate Website Instructions

## Overview

Build a 5-page corporate website for **LearnForge**, an all-in-one platform where creators build and sell online courses, coaching, digital downloads, and memberships. The site targets online educators, course creators, coaches, and businesses selling digital knowledge products. The primary conversion goal is **free-trial signups**.

## Visual Direction

Adopt a **modern, bold, professional** aesthetic. Use a vibrant primary color (electric blue or deep indigo) paired with energetic accents (coral or bright green) against clean white backgrounds. Typography should feel confident — a geometric sans-serif for headings (e.g., Inter or Plus Jakarta Sans) with generous sizing, and a readable body font. Use ample whitespace, rounded cards with subtle shadows, and smooth micro-animations on scroll. The overall mood should feel empowering and aspirational — creators should feel this platform will elevate their business.

## Key Priorities

- **Homepage is the conversion engine.** The hero section's tab-switching interaction (creator view vs. student view) is a signature moment — make it feel polished and immediate. The stats bar ($12B+, 120M+, 180 countries) should hit hard visually right below the hero.
- **Interactive elements are critical.** FAQ accordions appear on 4 of 5 pages, testimonial carousels on all 5, and the "Why Choose Us" tabbed feature section on the homepage — these must all function smoothly with vanilla JS.
- **Consistent navigation across all pages.** Every page shares a nav bar linking to all product pages (Online Courses, Digital Downloads, Memberships, Coaching) plus a prominent "Start Free Trial" CTA button.
- **Pricing overview on the homepage** should be clear and scannable — this is a key decision point for visitors.
- **Integrations sections** (Stripe, Zapier, Mailchimp, etc.) should use a clean logo grid to build trust through recognizable brands.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the complete section-by-section structure, all interaction definitions, and data display specifications for each page.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

56	**AI:** AI curriculum · AI lessons · AI lesson summaries · AI sales pages · AI subtitles · AI translations · AI quizzes
57	**Host:** Unlimited students · Unlimited videos · Embedded media · Downloadable files
58	**Manage:** Drip content · Course compliance · Email marketing · Custom domain · Sales analytics · External integrations · Public API · Webhooks
59	**Sell:** Memberships · Bundles · Subscriptions · Payment options · Tax handling · Upsells · Order bumps · Coupons · Affiliate marketing · Student referrals · Abandoned cart
60	
61	## Digital Downloads Value Proposition
62	- **Instant access, lasting impact** — From PDF templates to expert guides, downloads give students real-world value in real time.
63	- **Targeted and tangible** — Create downloads that solve problems, spark creativity, or speed up workflow.
64	- **Expand leads and learning** — Use digital downloads to hook leads, deepen learning, or boost the value of other products.
65	
66	## Supported File Types
67	Design files · Spreadsheets · Ebooks · Stock imagery · Email templates · Lesson plans · Asset libraries
68	
69	## Membership Benefits
70	- Students on memberships have a **43% higher lifetime value** than one-time students.
71	- **Build subscription tiers** — Provide access to different products, incentives, and exclusive content. Set monthly or annual pricing, or add a free trial.
72	- **A seamless student experience** — Students can upgrade, downgrade, and cancel memberships easily from their account.
73	
74	## Membership Resources
75	- **Build a powerful membership product** — Learn about the Membership product and how to build a powerful tier to earn more revenue.
76	- **10 tips for a successful membership site** — How to start a successful membership site generating consistent monthly income.
77	- **Case study: Building a successful membership site** — One creator shares how she turned her membership into a profitable business.
78	
79	## Coaching Setup Steps
80	1. **Create your coaching product** — Create, sell, and manage all aspects of your coaching business. Sell solo or alongside courses and downloads.
81	2. **Upload your content** — Customize content based on audience needs. Create milestones, schedule meetings, set up video calls, send messages and files.
82	3. **Customize and sell** — Offer a professional learning experience with easy-to-use, customizable sales pages.
83	
84	## Coaching Features
85	- **Payment processing and more** — Automated payments, fraud protection, tax-inclusive pricing, global currency conversion, 0% transaction fees on Pro and Business plans.
86	- **A personal touch** — Drag-and-drop builder and customizable templates to personalize coaching products. Manage assignments, schedule appointments, track client goals.
87	- **Scale made easy** — Average coaching price over $200. Built-in upsell and order bump features maximize earning potential.
88	- **Coach with care** — Customizable intake block and page editor give you control over who you onboard as a client.
89	
90	## Coaching Spotlight
91	- **Kinobody Fitness** — Greg O'Gallagher expanded from personal training to online fitness courses.
92	- **Tailored Tutors** — Making high-quality tutoring services available from anywhere with LearnForge.
93	- **UAV Coach** — 40,000+ students trained for FAA drone certification exams.
94	
95	## Integrations
96	Stripe · Zapier · Google Analytics · Mailchimp · Google Tag Manager · Zoom · AWeber · Pinterest · Unsplash · PayPal · HotJar · Google One Drive · TikTok · Segment · Meta · Dropbox · Google Drive · Calendly
97	
98	## Testimonials
99	- **Leila G., XelPlus Academy** — "Global Reach" — "With students from 188 countries, tax compliance could have been a nightmare. LearnForge handles it all, so we can focus on helping members upgrade their data skills."
100	- **Erin B., Virtual Assistant Coach** — "Full Control" — "You should never have anyone dictating the prices you charge. With LearnForge, you get full control—you can build real relationships instead of going through third parties."
101	- **Razvan C., Voxyde** — "Peace of Mind" — "LearnForge delivers excellent uptime. That peace of mind is invaluable. The built-in tax handling frees me to focus on creating content."
102	- **Francesco C., Vaporetto Italiano** — "Essential" — "LearnForge has been essential for reaching thousands of students worldwide. It handles payments, taxes, and enrollments so I can focus on the creative side."
103	- **Dan G., FlightInsight** — "10,000+ Students" — "What started as a few dozen students has grown into 10,000+ pilots worldwide. My courses run 24/7 while I focus on teaching."
104	- **Huzan R. & Nicoleta S., Speak Norsk** — "Made Simple" — "The platform made it simple to create and deliver our programs, and even let us offer a free course so students could get comfortable."
105	- **Anna G., The Science of Reading** — "Revenue Engine" — "I've been using LearnForge since 2017, and it continues to be a major revenue generator. Hands down the best platform."
106	
107	## Pricing Overview
108	**Flexible pricing tiers** — The business you want tomorrow starts with the plan you pick today. Plans start at $29/month after a free 7-day trial. 0% transaction fees on Builder, Growth, Advanced, and Unlimited plans. 7.5% transaction fee on Starter plan.
109	
110	**LearnForge Enterprise:** Premium solutions for professional learning at scale — SSO · Advanced reporting · Bulk sales and customer management · Native integrations and API · Dedicated success manager, priority support, and white-glove onboarding.
111	
112	**Free trial:** Discover your favorite features and ideal plan before you pay anything.
113	
114	## FAQ (Home)
115	- **Can I cancel my account at any time?** — Yes, simply cancel your account if LearnForge isn't right for you.
116	- **Can I change my plan once I sign up?** — Yes, change your plan at any time from your admin. New amount charged at next billing date.
117	- **Are there any transaction fees?** — 0% on Builder, Growth, Advanced, and Unlimited plans using LearnForge:pay. 7.5% on Starter plan. Standard processing fees may apply.
118	- **Who uses LearnForge?** — Creators, experts, entrepreneurs, and businesses serious about education—from language teachers to finance professionals to health and fitness leaders.
119	
120	## Footer Navigation
121	**Explore:** Pricing · Example Schools · Product Demo
122	**Company:** About us · Careers · Press · Partners · Newsletter
123	**Support:** Help Center · Blog · Pricing · House Rules · Content Guidelines

arguments.prompt:
Write the file /app/output/index.html for LearnForge's homepage. This is the main landing page and conversion engine for a corporate website about an all-in-one online education platform.

Use these exact link references:
- CSS: `<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">`
- JS: `<script src="main.js"></script>` (before closing body)
- Nav links: online-courses.html, digital-downloads.html, memberships.html, coaching.html
- Google Fonts already loaded in CSS, don't add another link

The page must include these sections IN ORDER:

1. **NAV** - Sticky nav with logo "Learn**Forge**" (Forge in accent color), links to Online Courses, Digital Downloads, Memberships, Coaching, and a "Start Free Trial" CTA button. Include hamburger for mobile.

2. **HERO** - Title: "The future of your education business happens here". Subtitle: "Whatever your expertise—languages, fitness, or coding—LearnForge helps you deliver impactful learning, run a smarter business, and scale worldwide." Two CTAs: "Start for free" (btn-primary) and "Explore our plans" (btn-outline). Below: Tab toggle with "Your view" and "Your student's view" buttons. Each tab shows a mock UI (creator admin panel vs student dashboard). Use data-tab-group, data-tab, and data-tab-panel attributes.

3. **STATS BAR** - Dark background. Three stats: "$12B+" / "Earned by creators", "120M+" / "Students served", "180 countries" / "Global reach"

4. **PRODUCTS** - Section header "What will you create?", 4 cards grid:
   - Online Courses (📚 blue icon) — "Maximize student engagement with videos, quizzes, drip content, and mobile access."
   - Coaching (🎯 coral icon) — "Offer one-on-one or group sessions, with easy scheduling and payment management."
   - Digital Downloads (📥 green icon) — "Sell templates, guides, and resources your audience can instantly access and use."
   - Memberships (🔄 purple icon) — "Build recurring revenue and stronger community with flexible subscription models."

5. **WHY CHOOSE US** - Tabbed section. 4 tabs: "More time for what matters", "Made for the modern learner", "Business growth that lasts", "Made to adapt and evolve". Use .why-tab buttons with data-why attributes and .why-panel divs with data-why-panel attributes.

Tab 1 features: Drag-and-drop course builders, Built-in AI creation and translation tools, Sales and VAT tax handling, Tax filing and affiliate payouts, Assisted migration and custom support
Tab 2: Innovative student dashboard, iOS and Android mobile apps, Drip content, Quizzes and completion certificates
Tab 3: Automated upsells and order bumps, Cross-promotional tools built into dashboard, Coupons and flexible payment options, Global payments and tax support
Tab 4: Intuitive 3rd-party app integrations, Embeddable product cards and buy buttons, Developer-friendly tools like APIs and webhooks

6. **AI & AUTOMATIONS** - Section on dark background. Header: "AI-powered. Human-led." with features listed in cards: AI curriculum, AI lessons, AI lesson summaries, AI sales pages, AI subtitles, AI translations, AI quizzes.

7. **TESTIMONIALS** - Carousel with prev/next. Cards for all 7 testimonials:
   - Leila G., XelPlus Academy — "Global Reach" tag — full quote
   - Erin B., Virtual Assistant Coach — "Full Control" tag
   - Razvan C., Voxyde — "Peace of Mind" tag
   - Francesco C., Vaporetto Italiano — "Essential" tag
   - Dan G., FlightInsight — "10,000+ Students" tag
   - Huzan R. & Nicoleta S., Speak Norsk — "Made Simple" tag
   - Anna G., The Science of Reading — "Revenue Engine" tag
   Use .testimonials-carousel, .testimonials-track, .testimonial-card, .carousel-controls, .carousel-prev, .carousel-next

8. **PRICING OVERVIEW** - .pricing-highlight card. "Plans that grow with you" heading. "The business you want tomorrow starts with the plan you pick today." Description mentioning starts at $29/month after free 7-day trial. 0% transaction fees on most plans, 7.5% on Starter. Features list with check marks: Free 7-day trial, 0% transaction fees on most plans, Enterprise solutions available. Two CTAs: "Start Free Trial" (btn-lime) and "Compare Plans" (btn with white border).

9. **INTEGRATIONS** - Grid of integration badges: Stripe, Zapier, Google Analytics, Mailchimp, Google Tag Manager, Zoom, AWeber, Pinterest, Unsplash, PayPal, HotJar, Google One Drive, TikTok, Segment, Meta, Dropbox, Google Drive, Calendly. Use .integrations-grid > .integration-item

10. **SOCIAL PROOF** - Simple bar: "Trusted by 120M+ students and thousands of creators worldwide"

11. **FAQ** - Accordion with 4 questions:
    - Can I cancel my account at any time? — Yes, simply cancel your account if LearnForge isn't right for you.
    - Can I change my plan once I sign up? — Yes, change your plan at any time from your admin. New amount charged at next billing date.
    - Are there any transaction fees? — 0% on Builder, Growth, Advanced, and Unlimited plans using LearnForge:pay. 7.5% on Starter plan. Standard processing fees may apply.
    - Who uses LearnForge? — Creators, experts, entrepreneurs, and businesses serious about education—from language teachers to finance professionals to health and fitness leaders.
    Use .faq-list > .faq-item with .faq-question button and .faq-answer > .faq-answer-inner

12. **FOOTER** - Dark background. 5-column grid:
    Col 1: LearnForge brand + description
    Col 2 "Explore": Pricing, Example Schools, Product Demo
    Col 3 "Company": About us, Careers, Press, Partners, Newsletter
    Col 4 "Support": Help Center, Blog, Pricing, House Rules, Content Guidelines
    Col 5 "Legal": Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Cookies Policy, Ethics Line, Accessibility
    Footer bottom: © 2026 LearnForge. All rights reserved.

Add class="fade-up" to section contents for scroll animation. Make sure all interactive elements use the correct data attributes for the JS in main.js. Use semantic HTML5. The page should be a complete, valid HTML document with proper meta tags, viewport, and title "LearnForge — Build & Sell Online Courses, Coaching, Memberships & More".

For the mock UIs in the hero tabs:
- Creator view: mock-ui with header (3 dots), sidebar (5 items, 2nd active), main area with cards
- Student view: mock-ui with header (3 dots), no sidebar, main area with 3 cards + a tall card

IMPORTANT: Write the complete file using the Write tool. Do not truncate or abbreviate any section.

The `container` class is on the inner div, so it's:

- `.nav` → `padding: 0 24px`
- `.container.nav-inner` → `max-width: 1200px, margin: 0 auto, padding: 0 24px`

This means the inner content has 24+24=48px horizontal padding. That's a bit much but not broken. Let me leave it — the overall layout will work fine.

steps.message:
All 5 pages of the LearnForge corporate website are complete. Here's the summary:

**Output files in `/app/output/`:**
- `index.html` — Homepage with hero tab-switcher, stats bar, product grid, "Why Choose Us" tabbed section, AI features, testimonials carousel, pricing overview, integrations grid, FAQ accordion, footer
- `online-courses.html` — Course product page with engagement features, course builder, product demo accordion, sales hub, tools grid
- `digital-downloads.html` — Downloads page with value props, create-and-sell section, business fit, file types grid
- `memberships.html` — Memberships page with 43% LTV stat, subscription tiers, pricing, resources
- `coaching.html` — Coaching page with 3-step setup, features, spotlight section, resources
- `styles.css` — Complete design system (1,150+ lines) with responsive breakpoints
- `main.js` — Vanilla JS for all interactions: hero tab toggle, "Why Choose Us" tabs, FAQ accordions, testimonial carousels, mobile nav, scroll animations

**Key interactive elements:** All use vanilla JS with no dependencies. Hero tab-switching, 4-tab feature selector, FAQ accordions on 4 pages, testimonial carousels on all 5 pages, and mobile hamburger nav all function via shared `main.js`. All pages open directly in a browser with relative paths.
